content_nodes.note: whole row; title, body, parent, sort, hidden, space, deleted state each on their own; tag_schema per key and collection_views per view as separate stamps (S3, table_name 'content_nodes.tag_schema' / 'content_nodes.collection_views')

node_attributes.note: per (note, key), only what a person or automation wrote (source ui / explicit / dispatcher); tombstone on delete (S2); a board's _canvas_sections per section (S3, table_name 'node_attributes._canvas_sections')

node_tags.note: per (note, tag); tombstone on remove; apply / remove in structure_log (S2)

node_edges.note: only hand-made edges (origin manual), keyed by what they connect; the automatic ones are derived (S2)

note_pointers.note: per pointer, keyed by an id derived from (parent, target); sort position and label each on their own (S2)

node_positions.note: per card: position, look and sub-board each on their own; a drag run is merged in structure_log (S2)

spaces.note: name, kind, owner and deleted state; each capability switch on its own, switches also in structure_log (S3)

space_members.note: per (space, member), permission in structure_log; tombstone on remove, also when the whole space is deleted (S3)

function_refs.note: per reference (function, instance, holder); config per key (S1 + S3 pattern, migration 201; table_name 'function_refs' and 'function_refs.config')

block_anchors.note: the anchor's identity; the position is derived

read_later_done_removed_192.note: per row; personal data; kept one release after read-later was removed (migration 192)

rss_subscriptions.note: the settings; the fetch state (etag, last fetch) belongs to the node on duty

external_calendars.note: name, color, enabled; the address is a sealed secret

workspaces.note: time zone, day-change hour; each module switch on its own (modules_off, modules_confirmed) (S3)

block_nodes.note: worked out from note text (tasks and split-out blocks are decided separately)

external_calendar_events.note: replaced as a whole on every fetch

domain_events.note: each node's own history and undo ledger

agent_sessions.note: belongs to the node on duty

ai_credentials.note: belongs to the node on duty

publish_snapshots.note: belongs to the node on duty

backup_restore_jobs.note: belongs to the node on duty

sync_stamps.note: the stamps themselves are what is copied, with the data they describe (S1)

structure_log.note: each node's own history of structure; never sent (S1, proposal §8.5)

blobs.note: keyed by content hash, cannot conflict; whether every node keeps a copy is decided after launch

ink_chunks.note: the earlier versions of a big drawing as chunks of one note, content-addressed within the note (note, hash), cannot conflict; History's copy like blobs, decided after launch. Not stamped (no trigger, no genesis pass): the drawing itself is the stamped node_attributes row, a chunk is only a copy a version names

ink_manifests.note: which chunks make up each earlier version of a big drawing, keyed by (note, content hash), cannot conflict; as ink_chunks

actors.note: identity: only changed on the main server

agent_runners.note: the proposal does not name this table

agent_session_events.note: the proposal does not name this table

agent_tokens.note: the proposal does not name this table

ai_suggestions.note: the proposal does not name this table

block_node_tags.note: per (paragraph, tag); tombstone on delete (S2; the proposal's tag-apply row, extended to paragraph tags)

board_copy_folds.note: the proposal does not name this table

board_copy_unparents.note: the proposal does not name this table

board_ink_moves.note: the proposal does not name this table

canvas_note_conversions.note: the proposal does not name this table

dispatcher_pending.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_capture_cursor.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_captured_events.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_node.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_ops.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_peers.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_projection_failures.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_rejections.note: the proposal does not name this table

ds_unsupported.note: the proposal does not name this table

event_reviews.note: the proposal does not name this table

member_removals.note: the proposal does not name this table

owner_member_migration_log.note: the proposal does not name this table

push_reminder_sent.note: the proposal does not name this table

push_subscriptions.note: the proposal does not name this table

schema_migrations.note: the proposal does not name this table

snapshot_media.note: the proposal does not name this table

browser_app_state.note: the browser version's own state (which sample notes it made); made by browser/sampleNotes.ts, not by a migration

sync_clock.note: this node's sequence number and clock, one row per workspace (S1)

id_rewrites.note: what migration 201 changed on this node (old id -> new id), so restoring an older event follows it; another node computes its own, never copied
